page.overview:
Who is Harine?

Harine was seen with the other children at the Konoha orphanage. He was present when Nonō Yakushi was thinking of a name for Kabuto.

Harine wasn't impressed by Nonō Yakushi's idea to name Kabuto after a helmet. Harine is proud of how thick his hair is, so thick that one cannot comb it.

Harine has tall, thick spiky blue hair resembeling a hedgehog. He has black-coloured eyes. He wore a grey shirt with three blue coloured stripes.

Harine, along with Urushi and an unnamed girl, is summoned into battle by a young Kabuto Yakushi in Naruto Mobile, where Harine demonstrates good skills in bojutsu, and also uses balloons to which he attaches many explosive tags and sends them towards the enemy.
